chunks: Surely the unbelievers among the people of the Book and the idolaters, will abide in the fire of Hell. They are the worst of creatures.
ai.seo_question: Who are considered the worst of creatures in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Bayyinah is often contextualized within the political and theological struggles of the early Islamic community, particularly regarding the covenant-keeping status of Jewish and Christian tribes in Medina. The designation 'worst of creatures' (sharr al-bariyyah) highlights not merely their disbelief, but their active opposition to the divine message despite having received prior revelation, distinguishing them from the 'People of the Book' who remained faithful to their covenants.
